harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.description: Does keeping dangerous retreat grids out of stair routes stop retreat and stair-flight oscillations? Generated from definitions/reborn-retreat-flight-pilot.yaml: 2 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-retreat-flight-e43b6d87, suite classes-18-300k.
experiment.name: reborn-retreat-flight-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-22: borg-reborn-rs request (RULES 20), filed as borg-zoo#657; zoo owner, 2026-11-22: "yes do all that" (the pilot only).
experiment.prespecified:
For each matched seed and arm, count episodes where a tactical retreat
(Retreating to or Backing up to) and a stair-flow step repeatedly return
to the same hazardous square. Include both one and two alternate retreat
landings. Report length, turns until progress toward a staircase or escape,
damage, and the number of guard activations. Report cap survivors, deaths,
unfinished cells, max depths and new loops in either arm. If neither arm
exposes the behavior, report the missing exposure. The pilot is descriptive.
experiment.question: Does keeping dangerous retreat grids out of stair routes stop retreat and stair-flight oscillations?
